title: State, Lifecycle, and Event Handling
description: Understand how to manage local component state, respond to user events, and use lifecycle methods for better control over component behavior.

lessons.title: What is State in React?
lessons.content: State is a built-in object used to track data that changes over time. When state updates, the component re-renders to reflect those changes.

lessons.title: Using useState Hook
Handling Events in React
Synthetic Events in React
lessons.content: React wraps native events in SyntheticEvent, providing cross-browser compatibility and consistent behavior.

lessons.title: Controlled Components and Forms
Introduction to Lifecycle Methods
lessons.content: React lifecycle methods let you run code at specific stages: when a component mounts, updates, or unmounts.

lessons.title: Using useEffect for Lifecycle Behavior
Cleanup Functions in useEffect
lessons.content: Cleanup functions run when the component unmounts or before the effect runs again, useful for timers, subscriptions, etc.

lessons.title: State vs Props
lessons.content: Props are read-only and passed from parent to child. State is local and managed within the component. Props make components reusable; state makes them interactive.
